verdict.rationale: gstack keeps a public CHANGELOG.md with entries describing behavior changes (gstack-docs-33). Its /gstack-upgrade skill runs the upgrade and then shows what's new (gstack-docs-7), so developers get release notes as part of updating. The docs describe the notes appearing after the upgrade runs, so seeing changes before updating means reading the changelog on GitHub manually. missing for 10: a documented pre-update preview of changes, evidence that changelog entries are organized per skill, independent or hands-on corroboration of changelog quality.
